prompt:
Write a police officer's crash report narrative (about 150 words). Collision type: hit while turning left in Katy, Texas. The claimant was a driver and reported whiplash. Refer to people as Driver 1, Driver 2 or Passenger. No names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1146; do not mention it.) Work these facts into the text naturally, in your own words, without listing them:
- The reported injury is plausible for a crash like this one.
- Witnesses, photos and the other driver all confirm the accident happened as described.
- It is not clear whether all of the damage came from this impact.
- The police and witnesses confirm the claimant was in the vehicle.
- No earlier damage to the vehicle is known.
- The driver is named on the policy.
text: Driver 1 was traveling in the left lane on a commercial roadway in Katy, Texas, when the vehicle began a left turn across oncoming traffic. Driver 2, approaching from the opposite direction, was unable to stop in time, and the front of Driver 2's vehicle struck the driver's side of Driver 1's vehicle. Passenger was seated in the front passenger position at the time of impact and was confirmed to be present in the vehicle by responding officers and by statements from both drivers. Driver 1 reported neck pain consistent with whiplash and was transported for evaluation; the reported injury is consistent with the mechanism of a broadside collision of this type. Two independent witnesses gave accounts matching the sequence described by both drivers, and scene photographs are consistent with those accounts. Driver 2 acknowledged the collision occurred as Driver 1 described it. Driver 1 is listed as a named insured on the policy under which the vehicle is covered. Officers observed no prior damage to the vehicle, and no earlier repairs were reported. It is not possible to determine from the scene alone whether all of the visible damage resulted from this impact, and a further inspection of the vehicle is recommended to separate any pre-existing wear from damage sustained in this collision.
